verses.sloka: ततः परिषदं सर्वामामन्त्र्य वसुधाधिपः ।हितमुद्धर्षणं चैवमुवाच प्रथितं वचः ॥२-२-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pariṣadaṁ sarvāmāmantrya vasudhādhipaḥ ।hitamuddharṣaṇaṁ caivamuvāca prathitaṁ vacaḥ ॥2-2-1॥

translations.english: Thereafter, the lord of the earth (king Dasaratha) addressed the entire assembly of invitees. He spoke these pleasing words aimed at their welfare which thrilled and delighted the hearts (of the assembled kings):
translations.hindi: उधर महाराज दशरथ राम से यह कह कि, कल तुम युवराज दु पर अभिषिक्त किए जाओगे, पुरोहित वसिष्ठ जी को बुला, उनसे बोले

verses.sloka: दुन्धुभिस्वनकल्पेन गम्भीरेणानुनादिना ।स्वरेण महता राजा जीमूत इव नादयन् ॥२-२-२॥
verses.transliteration: dundhubhisvanakalpena gambhīreṇānunādinā ।svareṇa mahatā rājā jīmūta iva nādayan ॥2-2-2॥

translations.english: ﻿ Lord of men (king Dasaratha) addressed the feudatory kings with words deep, resonant, loud like the kettledrum or the rumbling cloud, in a delightful, incomparable and attractive voice that carried all the dignity of royalty:

verses.sloka: राजलक्षणयुक्तेन कान्तेनानुपमेन च ।उवाच रसयुक्तेन स्वरेण नृपतिर्नृपान् ॥२-२-३॥
verses.transliteration: rājalakṣaṇayuktena kāntenānupamena ca ।uvāca rasayuktena svareṇa nṛpatirnṛpān ॥2-2-3॥

translations.english: ﻿ Lord of men (king Dasaratha) addressed the feudatory kings with words deep, resonant, loud like the kettledrum or the rumbling cloud, in a delightful, incomparable and attractive voice that carried all the dignity of royalty:

verses.sloka: विदितं भवतामेतद्यथा मे राज्यमुत्तमम् ।पूर्वकैर्मम राजेन्द्रैस्सुतवत् परिपालितम् ॥२-२-४॥
verses.transliteration: viditaṁ bhavatāmetadyathā me rājyamuttamam ।pūrvakairmama rājendraissutavat paripālitam ॥2-2-4॥

translations.english: It is wellknown to all of you that people of this greatest kingdom were ruled by my predecessors who were great kings, who looked after the subjects as though they were their own children.
translations.hindi: श्वेत बादल के समान सफेद रङ्ग के, श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के भवन . में वसिष्ठ जी पहुँचे ओर तीन ड्योढ़ियों तक रथ ही में बैठे हुए चले गए

verses.sloka: सोऽहमिक्ष्ह्वाकुभिः सर्वैर्नरेन्द्रैः परिपालितम् ।श्रेयसा योक्तुकामोऽस्मि सुखार्हमखिलं जगत् ॥२-२-५॥
verses.transliteration: so'hamikṣhvākubhiḥ sarvairnarendraiḥ paripālitam ।śreyasā yoktukāmo'smi sukhārhamakhilaṁ jagat ॥2-2-5॥

translations.english: I desire to accomplish the welfare of this entire world which deserves the happiness brought about by the rule of all the Ikshvaku kings.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--उस काल में ब्राह्मण दो घोड़ों के रथ पर ही बैठ कर निकला करते थे । ] स रामभवर्न पाप्य पाण्डराम्रधनप्रभम्‌ । तिस्रः कक्ष्या रथनेव विवश मुनिसत्तम;

verses.sloka: मयाप्याचरितं पूर्वैः पन्थानमनुगच्छता ।प्रजा नित्यमनिद्रेण यथाशक्त्यभिरक्षिताः ॥२-२-६॥
verses.transliteration: mayāpyācaritaṁ pūrvaiḥ panthānamanugacchatā ।prajā nityamanidreṇa yathāśaktyabhirakṣitāḥ ॥2-2-6॥

translations.english: ﻿ Following the path of my forefathers I protected the people to the best of my ability by being ever vigilant.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! तुम्हारे पिता तुम्हारे ऊपर प्रसन्न हैं, कल तुम युव- राज-पद्‌ पाओगे । आज सीता सहित उपवास करो

verses.sloka: इदं शरीरं कृत्स्नस्य लोकस्य चरता हितम् ।पाण्दुरस्यातपत्रस्य च्छायायां जरितं मया ॥२-२-७॥
verses.transliteration: idaṁ śarīraṁ kṛtsnasya lokasya caratā hitam ।pāṇdurasyātapatrasya cchāyāyāṁ jaritaṁ mayā ॥2-2-7॥

translations.english: My body has attained old age after ruling the entire world ensuring the welfare of the people under the shade of royal white parasol.

verses.sloka: प्राप्य वर्षसहस्राणि बहू न्यायूंषि जीवतः ।जीर्णस्यास्य शरीरस्य विश्रान्ति मभिरोचये ॥२-२-८॥
verses.transliteration: prāpya varṣasahasrāṇi bahū nyāyūṁṣi jīvataḥ ।jīrṇasyāsya śarīrasya viśrānti mabhirocaye ॥2-2-8॥

translations.english: Having lived for thousands of years this body is now worn out due to old age and therefore I want rest.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--हाथ पकड़ कर बड़े को सवारी से उतारना यह प्रतिष्ठा- सूचक प्राचीन पद्धति है । ] स चेनं प्रश्रितं' दृष्टा रसंभाष्याभिप्रसाथ च। प्रिया. हर्षयन्‌ राममित्युवाच पुरोहितः

verses.sloka: राजप्रभावजुष्टाम् हि दुर्वहामजितेन्द्रियैः ।परिश्रान्तोऽस्मि लोकस्य गुर्वीं धर्मधुरं वहन् ॥२-२-९॥
verses.transliteration: rājaprabhāvajuṣṭām hi durvahāmajitendriyaiḥ ।pariśrānto'smi lokasya gurvīṁ dharmadhuraṁ vahan ॥2-2-9॥

translations.english: I am weary of carrying on the heavy burden of duty and find it difficult to sustain the rule of dharma. It can be shouldered by those who have royal qualities (of might, courage etc) and not by those who have not controlled their senses.

verses.sloka: सोऽहं विश्रममिच्छामि पुत्रं कृत्वा प्रजाहिते ।सन्निकृष्टानिमान् सर्वाननुमान्य द्विजर्षभान् ॥२-२-१०॥
verses.transliteration: so'haṁ viśramamicchāmi putraṁ kṛtvā prajāhite ।sannikṛṣṭānimān sarvānanumānya dvijarṣabhān ॥2-2-10॥

translations.english: Therefore, after convincing all of you, the best of (learned) brahmins present here, I intend to take rest by installing my son to look after the welfare of the people.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार प्रसन्न हो कर, राजा नहुष ने राजा ययाति को राज्य दिया था, उसी प्रकार महाराज दशरथ कल सवेरे युबराज- यद्‌ पर तुमको अभिषिक्त करगे

verses.sloka: अनुजातो हि मां सर्वैर्गुणैर्ज्येष्ठो ममात्मजः ।पुरन्दरसमो वीर्ये रामः परपुरंजयः ॥२-२-११॥
verses.transliteration: anujāto hi māṁ sarvairguṇairjyeṣṭho mamātmajaḥ ।purandarasamo vīrye rāmaḥ parapuraṁjayaḥ ॥2-2-11॥

translations.english: My eldest son Rama, inheriting every virtue of mine, is a conqueror of enemy cities and is equal to Indra in prowess.

verses.sloka: तं चन्द्रमिव पुष्येण युक्तं धर्मभृतां वरम् ।यौवराज्ये नियोक्तास्मि प्रीतः पुरुषपुङ्गवम् ॥२-२-१२॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ candramiva puṣyeṇa yuktaṁ dharmabhṛtāṁ varam ।yauvarājye niyoktāsmi prītaḥ puruṣapuṅgavam ॥2-2-12॥

translations.english: I propose to install him (Rama), foremost among upholders of righteousness and the best of men who resembles the Moon in brightness when in conjunction with Pushya star, as heirapparent to the throne.
translations.hindi: फिर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने राजगुरु वसिष्ठ जी का भली भाँति आद्र-सत्कार किया । राजगुरु उसे ग्रहण कर और बिदा हो, श्रीरामचन्द्र के घर से चले गए

verses.sloka: अनुरूपः स वै नाथो लक्ष्मीवान् लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।त्रैलोक्यमपि नाथेन येन स्यान्नाथवत्तरम् ॥२-२-१३॥
verses.transliteration: anurūpaḥ sa vai nātho lakṣmīvān lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।trailokyamapi nāthena yena syānnāthavattaram ॥2-2-13॥

translations.english: With him (Rama) as ruler, all the three worlds will also have a better protector.That elder brother of Lakshmana with signs of greatness is certainly the most befitting to rule this kingdom.
translations.hindi: इधर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी भी अपने सच्चे इष्टमित्रों के साथ आनन्द से बैठे हुए बातचीत करते रहे और फिर उनसे सम्मानित हो, तथा उन्हीं सब लोगों के कहने से घर के भीतर गए

verses.sloka: अनेन श्रेयसा सद्यः सम्योज्यैवमिमां महीम् ।गतक्लेशो भविष्यामि सुते तस्मिन्निवेश्य वै ॥२-२-१४॥
verses.transliteration: anena śreyasā sadyaḥ samyojyaivamimāṁ mahīm ।gatakleśo bhaviṣyāmi sute tasminniveśya vai ॥2-2-14॥

translations.english: I shall be relieved of my anxiety by entrusting the land (ruled by me) to my son (Rama) without any more delay and thus ensure the continued welfare of this world.
translations.hindi: उस समय श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के घर में प्रसन्नचित्त नरनारियों की भीड़ लग गई थी और उनके वहाँ एकत्रित होने से राजभवन की वैसी ही शोभा हो रही थी, जैसी शोभा बिकसित कमलो से भरे हुए सरोबर की मतवाले पत्तियों से होती है

verses.sloka: यदीदम् मेऽनुरूपार्धं मया साधु सुमन्त्रितम् ।भवन्तो मेऽनुमन्यन्तां कथं वा करवाण्यहम् ॥२-२-१५॥
verses.transliteration: yadīdam me'nurūpārdhaṁ mayā sādhu sumantritam ।bhavanto me'numanyantāṁ kathaṁ vā karavāṇyaham ॥2-2-15॥

translations.english: Although it (this decision) is personally favourable to me and I have decided after seeking good counsel, you should also give me your consent and tell me what I should do.

verses.sloka: यद्यप्येषा मम प्रीतिर्हितमन्यद्विचिन्त्यताम् ।अन्या मद्यस्थचिन्ता हि विमर्दाभ्यधिकोदया ॥२-२-१६॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapyeṣā mama prītirhitamanyadvicintyatām ।anyā madyasthacintā hi vimardābhyadhikodayā ॥2-2-16॥

translations.english: Although this is what I would like to do, please suggest alternative ways of achieving the welfare (of this kingdom). Deliberations by the unbiased (on this issue) may bring good.
translations.hindi: अयोध्या की चारों ओर की सड़क श्रीरामचन्द्र के अभिषे- कोत्सव को देखने के लिए उत्कण्ठित लोगों की भीड़ से भरी हुई थीं । आने-जाने का रास्ता नहीं रह गया था

verses.sloka: इति बृवन्तं मुदिताः प्रत्यनन्दन् नृपा नृपम् ।वृष्तिमन्तं महामेघं नर्दन्त इव बर्हिणः ॥२-२-१७॥
verses.transliteration: iti bṛvantaṁ muditāḥ pratyanandan nṛpā nṛpam ।vṛṣtimantaṁ mahāmeghaṁ nardanta iva barhiṇaḥ ॥2-2-17॥

translations.english: Having thus heard king Dasaratha speak, the kings acclaimed him with delight, like peacocks crying (in joy) to see thick clouds.
translations.hindi: मनुष्यों के दल के दल मारे हर्ष के कोलाहल करते हुए सड़कों पर चले जाते थे, उस समय उनका वह आनन्द्परिपूण कोलाहल ऐसा जान पड़ता था मानो समुद्र गरज रहा हो

verses.sloka: स्निग्धोऽनुनादी सम्जजञे तत्र हर्षसमीरितः ।जनौघोद्घुष्टसन्नादो विमानं कम्पयन्निव ॥२-२-१८॥
verses.transliteration: snigdho'nunādī samjajañe tatra harṣasamīritaḥ ।janaughodghuṣṭasannādo vimānaṁ kampayanniva ॥2-2-18॥

translations.english: There emanated cries of love and joy from the multitude of people (conveying their approval) whose reverberation seemed to shake the palace.
translations.hindi: उस दिन अयोध्यापुरी की सब सड़क स्वच्छ और छिड़की हुई थी । उनकी दोनों ओर बड़ी लंवी-लंबी पुष्पमालाए बन्द्नवार की तरह लटक रही थीं . और प्रत्येक घर ध्वजापताकाओं से -सुशोभित था

verses.sloka: तस्य धर्मार्थविदुषो भावमाजञाय सर्वशः ।ब्राह्मणा जनमुख्याश्च पौरजानपदैः सह ॥२-२-१९॥
verses.transliteration: tasya dharmārthaviduṣo bhāvamājañāya sarvaśaḥ ।brāhmaṇā janamukhyāśca paurajānapadaiḥ saha ॥2-2-19॥

translations.english: Brahmins, kings and other prominent men, inhabitants of towns and villages having fully known the views of Dasaratha who was conversant with artha and dharma joined together and deliberated. They thought out well and having arrived at unanimity in their thinking thus addressed the aged king Dasaratha.

verses.sloka: समेत्य मन्त्रयित्वा तु समतागतबुद्धयः ।ऊचुश्च मनसा जञात्वा वृद्धं दशरथं नृपम् ॥२-२-२०॥
verses.transliteration: sametya mantrayitvā tu samatāgatabuddhayaḥ ।ūcuśca manasā jañātvā vṛddhaṁ daśarathaṁ nṛpam ॥2-2-20॥

translations.english: Brahmins, kings and other prominent men, inhabitants of towns and villages having fully known the views of Dasaratha who was conversant with artha and dharma joined together and deliberated. They thought out well and having arrived at unanimity in their thinking thus addressed the aged king Dasaratha.
translations.hindi: प्रजाजनों के अलङ्कार रूप और आनन्द को बढ़ाने वाले उस महोत्सव को देखने के लिए सब लोग उत्सुक हो रहे. थे

verses.sloka: अनेकवर्षसाहस्रो वृद्धस्त्त्वमसि पार्थिव ।स रामं युवराजानमभिषिञ्चस्व पार्थिवम् ॥२-२-२१॥
verses.transliteration: anekavarṣasāhasro vṛddhasttvamasi pārthiva ।sa rāmaṁ yuvarājānamabhiṣiñcasva pārthivam ॥2-2-21॥

translations.english: O mighty king, you have grown many thousands of years old. Therefore, you should coronate Rama as prince regent of this kingdom.
translations.hindi: । सड़कों पर लोगों की भीड़ को बचाते हुए धीरे-धीरे, राजपुरो- हित बसिष्ठ जी राजमहल में पहुँचे

verses.sloka: इच्छामो हि महाबाहुं रघुवीरं महाबलम् ।गजेन महता यान्तं रामं छत्रावृताननम् ॥२-२-२२॥
verses.transliteration: icchāmo hi mahābāhuṁ raghuvīraṁ mahābalam ।gajena mahatā yāntaṁ rāmaṁ chatrāvṛtānanam ॥2-2-22॥

translations.english: We cherish to see the mightyarmed hero among the Raghus, Rama, riding on a majestic elephant, his countenance shadowed by the royal parasol.
translations.hindi: वसिष्ठ जी श्वेत मेघ के शिखर के समान महल की अटारी पर चढ़ कर, महाराज दशरथ से वैसे ही मिले, जैसे बृहस्पति जी , इन्द्र से मिलते हैं

verses.sloka: इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा तेषां मनःप्रियम् ।अजानन्निव जिजञासुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥२-२-२३॥
verses.transliteration: iti tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rājā teṣāṁ manaḥpriyam ।ajānanniva jijañāsuridaṁ vacanamabravīt ॥2-2-23॥

translations.english: Having heard them king Dasaratha, pretending as though he was not aware of their heart's desire but was now wishing to ascertain it, spoke these words:
translations.hindi: वसिष्ठ जी को आते देख महाराज अपना आसन छोड़ खड़े हो गए और जिस लिए उनको रामचन्द्र जी के पास भेजा थासो पूछा । उत्तर में मुनि ने जो बहाँ हुआ था सो सब कह सुनाया

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वैव वचनं यन्मे राघवं पतिमिच्छथ ।राजानः संशयोऽयं मे तदिदं ब्रूत तत्त्वतः ॥२-२-२४॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvaiva vacanaṁ yanme rāghavaṁ patimicchatha ।rājānaḥ saṁśayo'yaṁ me tadidaṁ brūta tattvataḥ ॥2-2-24॥

translations.english: O kings, soon after listening to my words, all of you wish Rama to be king. (But) I doubt (in my mind) whether you have said it from your heart৷৷

verses.sloka: कथं नु मयि धर्मेण पृथिवीमनुशासति ।भवन्तो द्रष्टुमिच्छन्ति युवराजं ममात्मजम् ॥२-२-२५॥
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ nu mayi dharmeṇa pṛthivīmanuśāsati ।bhavanto draṣṭumicchanti yuvarājaṁ mamātmajam ॥2-2-25॥

translations.english: When the earth is being ruled righteously by me why indeed you intend to see my son as prince regent?
translations.hindi: गुरु से पूछ और दरबारिया को बिदा कर, महाराज दशरथ अन्तःपुर को उसी प्रकार चले गए जिस प्रकार सिंह अपनी गुफा में चला जाता है

verses.sloka: ते तमूचुर्महात्मानं पौरजानपदैः सह ।बहवो नृप कल्याणा गुणाः पुत्रस्य सन्ति ते ॥२-२-२६॥
verses.transliteration: te tamūcurmahātmānaṁ paurajānapadaiḥ saha ।bahavo nṛpa kalyāṇā guṇāḥ putrasya santi te ॥2-2-26॥

translations.english: Those kings along with the inhabitants of towns and villages answered the magnanimous king: O king your son, indeed has many auspicious and admirable virtues.
translations.hindi: इति पञ्चम; सगः ॥ .__ इन्द्रभवन सदृश गृह्‌ में, जो भूषणो से अलङकृत युवतियों से भरा हुआ था, महाराज दशरथ ने प्रवेश किया और वे वहाँ एस शोभित हुए जैसे तारानाथ ( चन्द्रमा ) तारों सहित आकाश- मण्डल में सुशोभित होता है

verses.sloka: गुणान् गुणवतो देव देवकल्पस्य धीमतः ।प्रियानानन्ददान् कृत्स्नान् प्रवक्ष्यामोऽद्यतान् शृणु ॥२-२-२७॥
verses.transliteration: guṇān guṇavato deva devakalpasya dhīmataḥ ।priyānānandadān kṛtsnān pravakṣyāmo'dyatān śṛṇu ॥2-2-27॥

translations.english: O king, we shall now speak about those great virtues of the sagacious (Rama). Comparable to those of the gods, they are dear and a source of delight for every one. Please listen.

verses.sloka: दिव्यैर्गुणैः शक्रसमो रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ।इक्ष्वाकुभ्योऽपि सर्वेभ्यो ह्यतिरिक्तो विशांपते ॥२-२-२८॥
verses.transliteration: divyairguṇaiḥ śakrasamo rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ ।ikṣvākubhyo'pi sarvebhyo hyatirikto viśāṁpate ॥2-2-28॥

translations.english: Lord of the people Rama with his divine virtues is equal to Indra. He with his proven valour is exceptional among all the descendents of the Iksvakus.

verses.sloka: रामः सत्पुरुषो लोके सत्यधर्मपरायणः ।साक्ष्हाद्रामाद्विनिर्वृत्तो धर्मश्चापि श्रिया सह ॥२-२-२९॥
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ satpuruṣo loke satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।sākṣhādrāmādvinirvṛtto dharmaścāpi śriyā saha ॥2-2-29॥

translations.english: Devoted to truth and righteousness Rama is the most venerable among men in this world. Even righteousness along with prosperity flows directly from Rama.

verses.sloka: प्रजासुखत्वे चन्द्रस्य वसुधायाः क्ष्हमागुणैः ।बुध्या बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यो वीर्ये साक्षाच्छचीपतेः ॥२-२-३०॥
verses.transliteration: prajāsukhatve candrasya vasudhāyāḥ kṣhamāguṇaiḥ ।budhyā bṛhaspatestulyo vīrye sākṣācchacīpateḥ ॥2-2-30॥

translations.english: He is equal to the Moon in causing happiness to the people, to the earth in forbearance, to Brihaspati in wisdom and to Indra in prowess.

verses.sloka: धर्मजजञः सत्यसन्धश्च शीलवाननसूयकः ।क्षान्तः सान्त्वयिता श्लक्ष्ह्णः कृतजञो विजितेन्द्रियः ॥२-२-३१॥
verses.transliteration: dharmajajañaḥ satyasandhaśca śīlavānanasūyakaḥ ।kṣāntaḥ sāntvayitā ślakṣhṇaḥ kṛtajaño vijitendriyaḥ ॥2-2-31॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Rama knows the ways of righteousness. He is true to his word and free from envy. He possesses a sound character with forbearance, gentleness and a sense of gratitude. With his senses under control, he is a source of consolation (in stressful times).

verses.sloka: मृदुश्च स्थिरचित्तश्च सदा भव्योऽनसूयकः ।प्रियवादी च भूतानाम् सत्यवादी च राघवः ॥२-२-३२॥
verses.transliteration: mṛduśca sthiracittaśca sadā bhavyo'nasūyakaḥ ।priyavādī ca bhūtānām satyavādī ca rāghavaḥ ॥2-2-32॥

translations.english: This son of the Raghus (Rama) is softspoken, steadfast, always serene, truthful and free from envy. He is pleasing to all beings. He serves those elderly brahmins versed in many lores. With these virtues his incomparable glory, fame and splendour have steadily grown.

verses.sloka: बहुश्रुतानां वृद्धानां ब्राह्मणानामुपासिता ।तेना स्येहातुला कीर्तिर्यशस्तेजश्च वर्धते ॥२-२-३३॥
verses.transliteration: bahuśrutānāṁ vṛddhānāṁ brāhmaṇānāmupāsitā ।tenā syehātulā kīrtiryaśastejaśca vardhate ॥2-2-33॥

translations.english: This son of the Raghus (Rama) is softspoken, steadfast, always serene, truthful and free from envy. He is pleasing to all beings. He serves those elderly brahmins versed in many lores. With these virtues his incomparable glory, fame and splendour have steadily grown.

verses.sloka: देवासुरमनुष्याणां सर्वास्त्रेषु विशारदः ।सम्यग्विद्याव्रतस्नातो यथवत्साङ्गवेदवित् ॥२-२-३४॥
verses.transliteration: devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṁ sarvāstreṣu viśāradaḥ ।samyagvidyāvratasnāto yathavatsāṅgavedavit ॥2-2-34॥

translations.english: He is an expert in wielding all kinds of weapons available to devas, asuras and men. He has achieved mastery over all sciences and has appropriately acquired knowledge of the Vedas and its ancillary sciences.

verses.sloka: गान्धर्वे च भुवि श्रेष्ठो बभूव भरताग्रजः ।कल्याणाभिजनः साधुरदीनात्मा महामतिः ॥२-२-३५॥
verses.transliteration: gāndharve ca bhuvi śreṣṭho babhūva bharatāgrajaḥ ।kalyāṇābhijanaḥ sādhuradīnātmā mahāmatiḥ ॥2-2-35॥

translations.english: This elder brother of Bharata is the greatest exponent in music on earth. Pious, sagacious, free from meanness, he is of noble descent.

verses.sloka: द्विजैरभिविनीतश्च श्रेष्ठैर्धर्मार्थनैपुणैः ।यदा व्रजति संग्रामं ग्रामार्थे नगरस्य वा ॥२-२-३६॥
verses.transliteration: dvijairabhivinītaśca śreṣṭhairdharmārthanaipuṇaiḥ ।yadā vrajati saṁgrāmaṁ grāmārthe nagarasya vā ॥2-2-36॥

translations.english: Whenever he, wellinstructed in all matters by the best of brahmins wellversed in dharma and artha proceeds along with Lakshmana to wage a war for the sake of a village or a town, he never returns without conquering the enemy.

verses.sloka: गत्वा सौमित्रिसहितो नाविजित्य निवर्तते ।संग्रामात्पुनरागम्य कुङ्जरेण रथेन वा ॥२-२-३७॥
verses.transliteration: gatvā saumitrisahito nāvijitya nivartate ।saṁgrāmātpunarāgamya kuṅjareṇa rathena vā ॥2-2-37॥

translations.english: While returning from the battlefield, either on a chariot or an elephant Rama stops and enquires in detail and in order, the welfare of the citizens as he would do for his kith and kin. He enquires about the welfare of their children, sacred rituals, wives, their servants and disciples as a father would enquire of his sons.

verses.sloka: पौरान् स्वजनवन्नित्यम् कुशलं परिपृच्छति ।पुत्रेष्वग्निषु दारेषु प्रेष्यशिष्यगणेषु च ॥२-२-३८॥
verses.transliteration: paurān svajanavannityam kuśalaṁ paripṛcchati ।putreṣvagniṣu dāreṣu preṣyaśiṣyagaṇeṣu ca ॥2-2-38॥

translations.english: While returning from the battlefield, either on a chariot or an elephant Rama stops and enquires in detail and in order, the welfare of the citizens as he would do for his kith and kin. He enquires about the welfare of their children, sacred rituals, wives, their servants and disciples as a father would enquire of his sons.

verses.sloka: निखिलेनानुपूर्व्याच्च पिता पुत्रानिवौरसान् ।शुश्रूषन्ते च वः शिष्याः कचित्कर्मसु दंशिताः ॥२-२-३९॥
verses.transliteration: nikhilenānupūrvyācca pitā putrānivaurasān ।śuśrūṣante ca vaḥ śiṣyāḥ kacitkarmasu daṁśitāḥ ॥2-2-39॥

translations.english: Rama, a tiger among men, always enquires whether our disciples discharge their duties.

verses.sloka: इति नः पुरुषव्याघ्रः सदा रामोऽभिभाषते ।व्यसनेषु मनुष्याणां भृशं भवति दुःखितः ॥२-२-४०॥
verses.transliteration: iti naḥ puruṣavyāghraḥ sadā rāmo'bhibhāṣate ।vyasaneṣu manuṣyāṇāṁ bhṛśaṁ bhavati duḥkhitaḥ ॥2-2-40॥

translations.english: He grieves profoundly whenever people are afflicted by misfortunes (and) rejoices like a father on festive occasions.

verses.sloka: उत्सवेषु च सर्वेषु पितेव परितुष्यति ।सत्यवादी महेष्वासो वृद्धसेवी जितेन्द्रियः ॥२-२-४१॥
verses.transliteration: utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu piteva parituṣyati ।satyavādī maheṣvāso vṛddhasevī jitendriyaḥ ॥2-2-41॥

translations.english: . He is one who speaks the truth. He is a great archer, one who has conquered his senses and serves the aged. He speaks with a smile and protects dharma with all his heart.

verses.sloka: स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषी च धर्मं सर्वात्मना श्रितः ।सम्यग्योक्ता श्रेयसां च न विगृह्य कथारुचिः ॥२-२-४२॥
verses.transliteration: smitapūrvābhibhāṣī ca dharmaṁ sarvātmanā śritaḥ ।samyagyoktā śreyasāṁ ca na vigṛhya kathāruciḥ ॥2-2-42॥

translations.english: He helps those who take refuge in him. He is not interested in conversation leading to dissentions. But during debates he is eloquent like Brihaspati (establing the truth on the basis of reasoning).

verses.sloka: उत्तरोत्तरयुक्तौ च वक्ता वाचस्पतिर्यथा ।सुभ्रूरायतताम्राक्ष्हस्साक्ष्हाद्विष्णुरिव स्वयम् ॥२-२-४३॥
verses.transliteration: uttarottarayuktau ca vaktā vācaspatiryathā ।subhrūrāyatatāmrākṣhassākṣhādviṣṇuriva svayam ॥2-2-43॥

translations.english: ﻿ Rama, who is the source of delight to the world, has charming eyebrows and large coppercoloured eyes. He is endowed with heroism, bravery and valour like Visnu manifested.

verses.sloka: रामो लोकाभिरामोऽयं शौर्यवीर्यपराक्रमैः ।प्रजापालनतत्त्वजञो न रागोपहतेन्द्रियः ॥२-२-४४॥
verses.transliteration: rāmo lokābhirāmo'yaṁ śauryavīryaparākramaiḥ ।prajāpālanatattvajaño na rāgopahatendriyaḥ ॥2-2-44॥

translations.english: He is proficient in the ways and means of ruling the people. His senses are not overpowered by passion. He alone is capable of ruling the three worlds, what to speak the earth

verses.sloka: शक्तस्त्रैलोक्यमप्येको भोक्तुं किं नु महीमिमाम् ।नाऽस्य क्रोधः प्रसादश्च निरर्थोऽस्ति कदाचन ॥२-२-४५॥
verses.transliteration: śaktastrailokyamapyeko bhoktuṁ kiṁ nu mahīmimām ।nā'sya krodhaḥ prasādaśca nirartho'sti kadācana ॥2-2-45॥

translations.english: His anger or favour never goes in vain. He kills those who rightly deserve to be killed and flares not at those whose life is to be spared.

verses.sloka: हन्त्येव नियमाद्वध्यानवध्ये च न कुप्यति ।युनक्त्यर्थैः प्रहृष्टश्च तमसौ यत्र तुष्यति ॥२-२-४६॥
verses.transliteration: hantyeva niyamādvadhyānavadhye ca na kupyati ।yunaktyarthaiḥ prahṛṣṭaśca tamasau yatra tuṣyati ॥2-2-46॥

translations.english: When pleased, Rama bestows wealth. Like the Sun shining with his rays, He shines with his qualities of tranquil, charming and loving nature.

verses.sloka: शान्तैः सर्वप्रजाकान्तैः प्रीतिसंजननैर्नृणाम् ।गुणैर्विरुरुचे रामो दीप्तः सूर्य इवांशुभिः ॥२-२-४७॥
verses.transliteration: śāntaiḥ sarvaprajākāntaiḥ prītisaṁjananairnṛṇām ।guṇairviruruce rāmo dīptaḥ sūrya ivāṁśubhiḥ ॥2-2-47॥

translations.english: When pleased, Rama bestows wealth. Like the Sun shining with his rays, He shines with his qualities of tranquil, charming and loving nature.

verses.sloka: तमेवंगुणसम्पन्नं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् ।लोकपालोपमं नाथमकामयत मेदिनी ॥२-२-४८॥
verses.transliteration: tamevaṁguṇasampannaṁ rāmaṁ satyaparākramam ।lokapālopamaṁ nāthamakāmayata medinī ॥2-2-48॥

translations.english: The earth desired to have Rama, richly endowed with such virtues, possessing proven prowess, comparable to Indra and other regents of the world, as her lord.

verses.sloka: वत्सः श्रेयसि जातस्ते दिष्ट्यासौ तव राघव ।दिष्ट्या पुत्रगुणैर्युक्तो मारीच इव काश्यपः ॥२-२-४९॥
verses.transliteration: vatsaḥ śreyasi jātaste diṣṭyāsau tava rāghava ।diṣṭyā putraguṇairyukto mārīca iva kāśyapaḥ ॥2-2-49॥

translations.english: O son of the Raghus (Dasaratha), because of your good fortune that Rama, endowed with the qualities of an ideal son like Kasyapa to Maricha was born to you for the welfare of this world.

verses.sloka: बलमारोग्यमायुश्च रामस्य विदितात्मनः ।देवासुरमनुष्येषु सगन्धर्वोरगेषु च ॥२-२-५०॥
verses.transliteration: balamārogyamāyuśca rāmasya viditātmanaḥ ।devāsuramanuṣyeṣu sagandharvorageṣu ca ॥2-2-50॥

translations.english: ﻿ Gandharvas, uragas, devas, asuras, the inhabitants of towns and villages, all men living in neighbouring or distant regions are wish the illustrious Rama strength, health and long life.

verses.sloka: आशंसते जनः सर्वो राष्ट्रे पुरवरे तथा ।आभ्यन्तरश्च बाह्यश्च पौरजानपदो जनः ॥२-२-५१॥
verses.transliteration: āśaṁsate janaḥ sarvo rāṣṭre puravare tathā ।ābhyantaraśca bāhyaśca paurajānapado janaḥ ॥2-2-51॥

translations.english: ﻿ Gandharvas, uragas, devas, asuras, the inhabitants of towns and villages, all men living in neighbouring or distant regions are wish the illustrious Rama strength, health and long life.

verses.sloka: स्त्रियो वृद्धास्तरुण्यश्च सायं प्रातः समाहिताः ।सर्वान् देवान् नमस्यन्ति रामस्यार्थे यशस्विनः ॥२-२-५२॥
verses.transliteration: striyo vṛddhāstaruṇyaśca sāyaṁ prātaḥ samāhitāḥ ।sarvān devān namasyanti rāmasyārthe yaśasvinaḥ ॥2-2-52॥

translations.english: Women, young and old alike devoutly invoke at dusk and at dawn all the gods for the sake of the celebrated Rama.

verses.sloka: तेषामायाचितं देव त्वत्प्रसादा त्समृद्ध्यताम् ।राममिन्दीवरश्यामं सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् ॥२-२-५३॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāmāyācitaṁ deva tvatprasādā tsamṛddhyatām ।rāmamindīvaraśyāmaṁ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇam ॥2-2-53॥

translations.english: O Lord let the peoples' prayer be fulfilled by your blessings. We would like to see your son Rama of the complexion of a bluelotus and destroyer of enemies as prince regent.

verses.sloka: पश्यामो यौवराज्यस्थं तव राजोत्तमाऽअत्मजम् ।तं देवदेवोपममात्मजं ते ।सर्वस्य लोकस्य हिते निविष्टम् ।हिताय नः क्ष्हिप्रमुदारजुष्टं ।मुदाभिषेक्तुम् वरद त्व मर्हसि ॥२-२-५४॥
verses.transliteration: paśyāmo yauvarājyasthaṁ tava rājottamā'atmajam ।taṁ devadevopamamātmajaṁ te ।sarvasya lokasya hite niviṣṭam ।hitāya naḥ kṣhipramudārajuṣṭaṁ ।mudābhiṣektum varada tva marhasi ॥2-2-54॥

translations.english: O bestower of boons it behoves you to install with delight and without delay your son (Rama) endowed with all virtues equal to god of the gods and committed to our wellbeing and to the welfare of this world, as your heirapparent. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वितीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the second sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
